about_the_game:
"Dice determine your steps, cards rewrite your rules —

In the gamble with the Demon, luck is the stake, strategy the ace."

A 2D pixel-art dice-driven strategy adventure blending mysterious Tarot card items, random event choices, and gambling showdowns, where the roll of dice writes the final chapter of the Demon's contract.

Core Gameplay: Dice as Destiny, Cards as Decree

The "Gambler," bound by a demonic contract, throws dice to selectively complete events, collect Tarot card items, and ultimately accumulate enough damage and resources in the Demon's Gamble to win freedom for their soul:

1. Dice-Driven Event Selection

Every step is a high-stakes gamble: movement, combat, and transactions all depend on dice rolls.
Event Chains & Resource Games:

  • 🔶 Gold Events

  • ❤️ Life Events

  • ⚡ Demon Damage Events

  • ⚔️ Demon Attack Events

2. Tarot Card Items: Aces to Rewrite Dice Rules

22 Tarot cards transform into key items, each capable of warping dice mechanics or event outcomes.

3. Demon's Gamble: The Ultimate Fate Duel

Stage Accumulation

Weaken the Demon's HP through events, preserve your own life, stockpile gold, and acquire items while navigating the Demon's escalating rules across each floor's fifth stage.

Gambling Mechanics

  • 🔄 Three rounds of ultimate duels where massive damage can decide the outcome in an instant.

  • HP is deducted alongside the Demon's, determining the final winner:

    • Proceed to the next floor

    • Claim freedom

    • Lose your soul to eternal damnation
